steps.title: Setup Project Structure
steps.description: Initialize the Android project directory structure and configuration files.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Scripts
steps.description: Define compilation target SDK, JVM version, and remove external dependencies to stick to the pure Android SDK.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Register MainActivity and declare the application theme and system permissions.

steps.title: Define Color Resources
steps.description: Create modern, premium, high-contrast dark palette colors for the calculator buttons and background.

steps.title: Define String Resources
steps.description: Add user interface strings and button text values to ensure localizable resources.

steps.title: Create Modern Button Backgrounds
steps.description: Generate rounded-corner custom drawable selectors for basic, operator, and action buttons.

steps.title: Create User Interface Layout
steps.description: Develop a sleek, modern, grid-based calculator interface with nested LinearLayouts, displaying formula, result, and history log.

steps.title: Implement Calculator Logic Model
steps.description: Create a native Java-based expression parser to calculate arithmetic operations with precision and error safety.

steps.title: Develop MainActivity Controller
steps.description: Wire up UI buttons to the input buffer, link back-end calculations, and handle orientation, state, and click interactions.

steps.title: Define API Schema configuration
steps.description: Create the required api_schema.json configuration for local processing.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Compile the application with Gradle debug assembler to generate the executable APK.
